methodology.price_source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, adjusted daily OHLC for SPY/QQQ and Cboe VIX history distributed via Yahoo Finance
methodology.horizon_definition: Trading sessions after the event date, not calendar days.
methodology.baseline: All eligible trading-day windows for the same symbol over the same available history.
methodology.returns: Adjusted-close forward returns from the event close.
methodology.path: Adjusted daily high/low path after the event close through the selected horizon.
methodology.hit_order: Upside/downside first-hit probabilities use the full eligible event sample. If both thresholds occur on the same daily bar, order is marked ambiguous rather than guessed.
methodology.lookahead: Signal detection uses only information available on or before the event close; future observations are used only for outcome measurement.
methodology.survivorship: V1 price studies use index ETFs and VIX, so constituent survivorship bias is not applicable. Future breadth studies must use point-in-time constituent membership or disclose the limitation.
methodology.one_week_participation: Market Pulse above_5d = percent of the tracked S&P 500 universe above its 5-day moving average, equivalent in concept to $MMFD. Breadth event studies use only prospectively recorded Market Pulse history and are explicitly labeled when sample depth is limited.
methodology.breadth_cycle: McClellan-style breadth momentum uses 19- and 39-session EMAs of normalized net advances from Market Pulse's recorded S&P 500 advance/decline universe. Percentile signals use trailing windows only.
methodology.current_close_conditions: Current-close studies are anchored to market_context.market_date, the dashboard's latest confirmed close. Price/VIX studies use historical SPY/QQQ/VIX data. Breadth studies use only prospectively recorded Market Pulse breadth history.

studies.title: QQQ - Breadth momentum begins recovering from an extreme

definition.rule: Breadth-momentum percentile crosses above 20 after reaching the bottom decile during the prior 10 sessions.
definition.event_logic: Transition event only; repeated days in the same state are not new signals.

diagnostics: Uses only recorded S&P 500 advance/decline observations. Breadth momentum is McClellan-style and normalized to this universe; it is not the NYSE McClellan Oscillator.
studies.commentary: Only 4 complete 5-day examples are available in the verified breadth history, so this is early evidence only.

studies.title: QQQ Oversold selloff with VIX >25

definition.rule: RSI(14) <35 AND three-session return <=-3% AND VIX >25; triggers only when the full condition first becomes true.
definition.event_logic: Transition/crossing event; repeated persistent observations are not counted unless the rule explicitly says so.

diagnostics: Outcomes have wide historical dispersion.

definition.event_logic: Transition event only; repeated days in the same state are not new signals.

diagnostics: Uses only recorded S&P 500 advance/decline observations. Breadth momentum is McClellan-style and normalized to this universe; it is not the NYSE McClellan Oscillator.
studies.commentary: Only 2 complete 5-day examples are available in the verified breadth history, so this is early evidence only.

studies.title: SPY Oversold selloff with VIX >25

definition.rule: RSI(14) <35 AND three-session return <=-3% AND VIX >25; triggers only when the full condition first becomes true.
definition.event_logic: Transition/crossing event; repeated persistent observations are not counted unless the rule explicitly says so.

diagnostics: Outcomes have wide historical dispersion.
studies.commentary: Historically, the 5-day outcome after this setup was not materially different than a normal SPY 5-day period. The median was +0.49% and 60% of prior occurrences finished higher versus 58% normally. Historical precedent is context, not a forecast.

studies.title: Intermediate breadth neutral while long-term participation stays healthy

definition.rule: 50-day breadth is between 45% and 60% while 200-day breadth is at least 60%.

diagnostics: Breadth studies use only Market Pulse's prospectively recorded S&P 500 breadth history; sample depth is limited and grows daily.
Condition-at-close studies can contain overlapping historical windows; use them as context, not independent trials.
